description: This file implements logging functionality for the 'angel' module within the lighttpd project, including initialization, cleanup, message writing with timestamp support, and line splitting utilities.

methods.name: void li_log_init(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Initializes the logging system for a given server, setting default log levels and creating timestamp and log line buffers.

methods.name: void li_log_clean(liServer * srv)
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for timestamp cache and log line buffers.

methods.name: void li_log_write(liServer * srv,liLogLevel log_level,guint flags,const gchar * fmt,...)
methods.description: Writes a log message at a specified level with optional timestamp; outputs to stderr.

methods.name: void li_log_split_lines(liServer * srv,liLogLevel log_level,guint flags,gchar * txt,const gchar * prefix)
methods.description: Splits a text into multiple lines with a prefix and logs each line.

methods.name: void li_log_split_lines_(liServer * srv,liLogLevel log_level,guint flags,gchar * txt,const gchar * fmt,...)
methods.description: Splits multiline text into individual lines with a formatted prefix, then logs each line.
